help.index.intro: Short answers to “how do I…” for this admin. Each article says what the shop really does and links to the screen where you do it.
help.search.label: Search the help
help.search.hint: Type a word in Ukrainian or English, for example “price” or “ціна”.
help.search.none: No article matches “{query}”. Try another word or browse the topics below.
help.topics.title: Topics
help.article.notFoundTitle: This help article does not exist
help.article.notFoundBody: The address may be mistyped, or the article was renamed. Look for it in the list.
help.screen.notAllowed: Screen “{screen}”: your role cannot open it. Ask a shop owner if you need it.
help.checklist.title: Getting started
help.checklist.intro: Set up the shop in this order. The shop checks most steps itself from its own data when this page opens.
help.checklist.manualHint: The admin cannot check this step: tick it yourself. The tick is kept in this browser only.
help.checklist.hiddenOnHome: The checklist is hidden from the start page.
help.checklist.restore: Show on the start page again
help.checklist.hiddenNotice: The checklist is hidden. You find it under Help.
help.checklist.storageFailed: This browser does not let the admin remember the change; it lasts until you leave the page.
help.checklist.step.productTypes.title: Product types, attributes and options
help.checklist.step.productTypes.text: Done when at least one product type exists.
help.checklist.step.categories.title: Categories
help.checklist.step.categories.text: Done when at least one category exists.
help.checklist.step.firstProduct.title: First product with variants
help.checklist.step.firstProduct.text: Done when at least one product exists (every product has at least one variant).
help.checklist.step.prices.title: Prices and publishing
help.checklist.step.prices.text: Done when a product is published: publishing needs a price in the shop currency on every active variant.
help.checklist.step.stock.title: Stock
help.checklist.step.stock.text: Done when one of the five newest published products has stock available, or does not count stock.
help.checklist.step.shipping.title: Delivery method
help.checklist.step.shipping.text: Done when a delivery method is switched on. Without one, checkout runs without a delivery choice.
help.checklist.step.payments.title: Online payment
help.checklist.step.payments.text: Done when the server has a payment provider switched on. The admin cannot tell whether it is the test provider: ask your developer.
help.checklist.step.email.title: Email
help.checklist.step.email.text: Done when the server has a mail provider. The test provider “fake” delivers nothing.
help.checklist.step.legal.title: Legal texts
help.checklist.step.legal.text: The storefront's privacy policy, terms and cookie page ship as placeholders. Replace them with texts your lawyer checked.
